title: An OpenCode setup helper
summary:
Claude got a new route and request fixes, OpenCode got a setup helper, and the app catalog gained ChatPUA.

Oh My Pollicode was added to install OpenCode and oh-my-opencode and write Pollinations provider and multi-agent model configuration. Less config editing before the agents start talking.

`claude` (Sonnet 4.5) and `claude-large` (Opus 4.5) were moved from Bedrock to Vertex AI to address token-rate limits; `claude-fast` stays on Bedrock. Follow-up fixes made Vertex responses pass OpenAI-style validation and gave requests that omit `max_tokens` a default, while still allowing callers to set their own.

Libre-Connect’s bilingual iOS roleplay chat app was added to the catalog and README’s recent apps list. It includes avatars, GIFs, groups and scenes.
